title: Two more Rochester residents plead guilty in Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
notes: Covers the Brava Restaurant & Cafe LLC (Rochester) family group within the Feeding Our Future prosecutions. Brava received $4.3 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds; six people connected to Brava were charged with 29 counts of wire fraud and money laundering.
supports: Sharmake Jama, a principal of Brava Restaurant & Cafe LLC, pleaded guilty on January 29, 2025.

Ayan Jama, the other principal of Brava Restaurant & Cafe LLC, pleaded guilty on January 31, 2025. She admitted using more than $775,000 of program funds for personal expenditures including property in Alanya, Turkey and homes in Rochester, Minnesota and Columbus, Ohio.
Zamzam Jama, who worked at Brava Restaurant, pleaded guilty to money laundering on February 5, 2025, admitting she used more than $111,000 for a Toyota RAV4 and a home in Rosemount, Minnesota.
As of this article's publication, sentencing had not yet been scheduled for Sharmake, Ayan, or Zamzam Jama.
Asha Jama and Mustafa Jama are listed as remaining defendants on the same indictment; this article does not give their plea status or dates.
